sloka: ततः सीता ददर्शोभौ शयानौ शरतल्पयोः ।लक्ष्मणं चापि रामं च विसञ्ज्ञौ शरपीडितौ ।। ६.४७.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sītā dadarśobhau śayānau śaratalpayoḥ ।lakṣmaṇaṁ cāpi rāmaṁ ca visañjñau śarapīḍitau ।। 6.47.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Sita beheld extremely happy Rakshasas, and grief stricken Vanaras, in great agony near Rama and Lakshmana.
